_comment: Trusted, human-reviewed policy for the dependency orchestrator. Read ONLY from main at a frozen SHA; never from a PR branch. Every switch defaults to the safest value. Hard safety rules (never-automatic categories, exact-SHA merge, CI/Staging/Migration gates) live in code and cannot be relaxed here.

branch_update._methods: api-update-branch (merge main into the Dependabot branch, App token) | dependabot-rebase (comment; skipped for branches carrying non-Dependabot commits)

risk._comment: Package categories raise risk. Categories listed in code as NEVER_AUTOMATIC (billing, auth/security, database, github-actions, framework, ai-accounting, sftp, css-framework) can only be merged by a human, even if listed in merge.approvals.

known_incompatibilities.name: tailwind-merge
known_incompatibilities.reason: tailwind-merge v3 only supports Tailwind CSS v4 class names; the repository is on Tailwind v3

repair._comment: The existing Claude Release Engineer is the only repair system. The orchestrator may dispatch it for a failed CI run on a dependency PR; it never pushes code itself.

_approval_example.head_sha: optional 40-hex pin; omit to approve the update set across branch refreshes
